title: New Discovery Boosts Petrobras' Expectations in the Amazon Mouth
subtitle: Petrobras Advances with New Oil Discovery in the Amazon Mouth Region
excerpt: President Magda Chambriard highlights the second oil discovery in an equatorial margin well, reinforcing the company's expectations in the Amazon Mouth.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Petrobras President, Magda Chambriard, stated this Friday (2) that the company made its second oil discovery in an equatorial margin well.

This new discovery raises Petrobras' expectations in the Amazon Mouth region, reinforcing the potential for energy resource development there.

The announcement strengthens the company's presence in the area, signaling continued oil exploration and production activities in the region.

With information from Agência Brasil.
